description.value: Marpole-Oakridge Community Centre is a long-established neighbourhood hub founded in 1949, jointly operated by the Vancouver Board of Parks and Recreation and the Marpole-Oakridge Community Association. Situated at the north end of Oak Park at West 59th Avenue and Oak Street, it houses a fitness centre with weight room, cardio room, racquetball court, whirlpool, and sauna, alongside a broad recreational program roster serving all ages. A new replacement facility is also in development, with imagery available on the centre's website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and actively promoting Spring & Summer 2026 programming (including a June 6, 2026 community day), confirming the centre is open. Phone 604.257.8180 and address 990 West 59th Avenue, Vancouver V6P 1X9 match OSM exactly; the website lists both marpolecc@vancouver.ca (primary institutional email) and marpoleoakridgecc@gmail.com (secondary, which OSM records). No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or showers appears in the fetched content, though a snack bar is referenced in the volunteer opportunities section indicating food service on site.
concerns: OSM email (marpoleoakridgecc@gmail.com) is a secondary contact; primary institutional email per website is marpolecc@vancouver.ca — both are listed on the contact page.

Website prominently references a 'NEW Marpole Community Centre' with images, suggesting a replacement facility may be under development or recently opened; the OSM record's address should be verified once the new facility opens.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active community centre with confirmed 2026 programming; useful to touring cyclists as a publicly accessible facility with fitness amenities including whirlpool and sauna.
